description: This is a Java source file defining the 'Publisher' class, which is an Akka actor responsible for publishing messages based on topic Bloom filters. It includes methods for creating publish commands, handling message publication, and referencing external dependencies like Akka actors, metrics, and pubsub data readers.

classes.name: Publisher
classes.description: An Akka actor class responsible for publishing messages to subscribers based on topic Bloom filters. It maintains counters for published messages and topics and handles the asynchronous publication process.

classes.name: Publish
classes.description: A static nested class representing a command to publish a message to a collection of topics. It includes the message payload and topic collection.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Factory method to create Props configuration for the Publisher actor, taking a DDataReader as a parameter.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines the actor's message handling behavior, specifically how to handle Publish messages and unhandled messages.

methods.name: publish
methods.description: Handles the publication of a message to subscribers, updating counters and asynchronously sending messages to subscriber actors.

methods.name: logUnhandled
methods.description: Logs messages that are received but not explicitly handled by the actor.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new Publish instruction with specified topics and message.

methods.name: getTopics
methods.description: Returns the collection of topics associated with a Publish command.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message payload associated with a Publish command.
